correctness.rationale: An explicitly specified 12-vertex, 18-edge graph has all 24 natural S4 automorphisms, which are all automorphisms because the four only triangles and their matching cross-edges determine labels. The standalone verifier independently enumerates 162 nonempty independent sets, 3342 nested flags and 146 barycentric flag-orbit cells. The 60 certificate pairs are checked sequentially as genuine elementary regular-CW collapses; the residual 26-cell subcomplex is a connected closed surface, with 6 vertices, 12 edges, 8 triangles, edge incidence 2 and cyclic vertex links checked with multiplicity. Euler characteristic 2 forces S2, hence the complete geometric quotient is simple-homotopy equivalent to S2. Limits are exactly this finite graph and action.

value.rationale: The graph is the unique 12-vertex Archimedean truncated-tetrahedral skeleton, equivalently the matching-graph model from a once-subdivided K4. Its complete group-quotient homotopy type is a canonical finite invariant already motivated by an existing exact representation and rational orbit-space study. Establishing a two-sphere collapse settles torsion and higher integral homotopy questions invisible to that rational classification. The 60-step cellular collapse is a reusable structural witness, not a mere unmotivated count.
